name: Gaussian Splatting in Style
definition: A method for stylizing complex 3D scenes by learning a mapping between 3D Gaussians and a queried style image, generating novel views conditioned on an input style image while preserving geometric consistency.
summary: Gaussian Splatting in Style is a method for real-time 3D scene stylization that learns a unified color module to predict RGB colors based on geometry and style, avoiding post-rendering 2D stylization.
